Build as a static Astro site; Pages Functions belong in `/functions` and only `/api/*` should route to Functions. Never put Cloudflare runtime secrets in public assets or Git. The approved brand source is `cashforphilly-brand-kit/`; do not use restricted trademark illustrations. Seller, agent, and investor consent flows are distinct. Production launch requires approved legal identity, email verification, real D1/Turnstile credentials, asset rights review and tested DNS preservation.
